title: 第147章 他不属于这一界
slug: 黄牛中介没想到你请得动真神啊
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

季伯渊点了点头：“张小友爽快，禁制就在后山，老朽这就带你去。”

他转过身对着几位长老挥了挥手：“都随我来。”

一行人出了天符殿，沿着后山的一条小径往下走。

张瑀跟在季伯渊旁边，宁霜序走在他身后半步的位置。

其余几位长老跟在后面，二长老走在最后，一边走一边低声和旁边的女长老说着什么。

大长老走在人群中间，脸色依然阴沉，但表面上已经恢复了正常。

走了大概一刻钟，前方出现了一片被临时围起来的区域。

区域的入口处站着四名手持符枪的内门弟子，看到宗主过来，同时躬身行礼，让开了道路。

季伯渊带着张瑀走进围栏，里面是一片被清理过的空地。

空地的尽头，是一座陡峭的石壁。

石壁高约数十丈，表面布满了密密麻麻的古老符文。

那些符文不是刻上去的，倒像是天然生长在石壁上的脉络，纹路古拙而深奥。

每一条纹路都在微微发光，光芒的颜色在五种色彩之间缓缓流转——金、青、蓝、红、黄，正对应着金木水火土五行。

五色光芒在石壁表面交织成一面巨大的禁制屏障。

屏障散发出来的灵力波动极其庞大，但所有的能量都被牢牢地锁在禁制内部，连一丝都没有外泄。

季伯渊指着那面石壁，语气凝重：“这就是上古遗迹的入口，我等尝试过数十种破阵方法，全都无功而返。”

二长老补充道：“我等也试过用蛮力攻击，但禁制会把攻击的力量加倍反弹回来。之前有位长老，强行攻击禁制，结果被反弹回来的力量震断了两根经脉。”

张瑀听完，没有说话。

他在心里默念系统。

“系统，扫描这片禁制。”

系统面板立刻弹了出来。

【正在扫描目标区域……】

【扫描进行中……】

【扫描完成。】

【禁制类型：上古五行封禁术·五元锁天阵】

【布阵年代：距今约三千二百年】

【布阵者：初步判定为元婴期以上修士，具体身份信息已遗失。】

【禁制结构：以金、木、水、火、土五行为基础，环环相扣，形成闭环能量场。阵眼共有一百零八处，分布在石壁表面及后方山体内部，每一处阵眼都与相邻阵眼相互制衡。破坏其中任何一处，其余阵眼会同时触发自毁机制，将石壁连同后方遗迹通道一并摧毁。】

【自毁机制触发条件：任意阵眼被暴力破坏；禁制内的五行平衡被打破超过三成；外界有金丹期以上强度的攻击直接命中禁制核心。】

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Ji Boyuan nodded: "Zhang Xiaoyou, the ban is at the back mountain. I will take you there right now."

He turned around and waved to several elders: "Follow me."

The group left Tianfu Hall and walked down a path in the back mountain.

Zhang Yu followed Ji Boyuan, and Ning Shuangxu walked half a step behind him.

The other elders followed, and the second elder walked at the end. As he walked, he whispered something to the female elder next to him.

The great elder walked among the crowd, his face still gloomy, but on the surface he had returned to normal.

After walking for about a quarter of an hour, a temporarily fenced area appeared ahead.

Four inner sect disciples holding talisman spears stood at the entrance of the area. When they saw the sect master coming, they bowed and saluted and moved out of the way.

Ji Boyuan took Zhang Yu into the fence, which was an open space that had been cleared.

At the end of the clearing is a steep rock wall.

The stone wall is about tens of feet high, and its surface is covered with dense ancient runes.

Those runes were not carved on them, but rather looked like veins growing naturally on the stone wall. The lines were ancient and profound.

Each line is glowing slightly, and the color of the light slowly flows between five colors-gold, cyan, blue, red, and yellow, which correspond to the five elements of gold, wood, water, fire, and earth.

Five-colored rays of light intertwined into a huge forbidden barrier on the surface of the stone wall.

The spiritual power fluctuations emitted by the barrier are extremely huge, but all the energy is firmly locked inside the restriction, without even a trace leaking out.

Ji Boyuan pointed at the stone wall and said in a solemn tone: "This is the entrance to the ancient ruins. We have tried dozens of ways to break the formation, but all failed."

The second elder added: "We have also tried to attack with brute force, but the restriction will double the power of the attack and bounce it back. An elder previously attacked the restriction forcefully, and the rebound force broke two meridians."

Zhang Yu didn't speak after listening.

He thought about the system silently in his mind.

"System, scan this restricted area."

The system panel popped up immediately.

[Scanning target area...]

[Scanning in progress...]

[Scan completed.】

[Restriction type: Ancient Five Elements Forbidden Technique·Five Elements Locking Formation]

[Era of formation: about 3,200 years ago]

[Arrayer: Preliminarily determined to be a monk at the Nascent Soul stage or above. The specific identity information has been lost.】

[Restricted structure: Based on the five elements of metal, wood, water, fire, and earth, they are interlocked to form a closed-loop energy field.There are a total of 108 formation eyes, distributed on the surface of the stone wall and inside the mountain behind. Each formation eye checks and balances with the adjacent formation eyes.If any one of them is destroyed, the other formation eyes will trigger the self-destruction mechanism at the same time, destroying the stone wall and the ruins passage behind it.】

[Conditions for triggering the self-destruction mechanism: Any array eye is violently destroyed; the balance of the five elements within the restriction is broken by more than 30%; attacks from the outside with intensity above the Golden Core stage directly hit the core of the restriction.】
